info.title: WG Chores API
info.description: Sessions: 30 days idle, at most 90 days (local accounts) or 30 days (SSO accounts) after sign-in. The admin command `wg-chores revoke-sessions <username>` deletes all sessions of a user; their next request gets 401 `unauthenticated`. App device tokens (bearer) have the same lifetimes.

post.summary: Sign in with a local account

400.description: `invalid_client`; `ambiguous_auth` when a browser sign-in carries a bearer token

client.description: `android`: answers `{token, user}` instead of setting the cookie

device_name.description: app only; cleaned, at most 60 characters, default `Android`

post.description: Deletes this session. Optional body `{push_endpoint}`: that push subscription is deleted too when it belongs to the signed-in user (sign-out on a shared device). An empty body is fine. With a bearer token: ends that device session, no cookie is touched.

client.description: `android`: answers `{token, user}` instead of setting the cookie

device_name.description: app only; cleaned, at most 60 characters, default `Android`

get.summary: One chore with its household id

post.summary: Mark done; the client-made uuid makes retries idempotent (200 replay, 201 new)

200.description: Replay: this id was already created in this chore; the stored completion is returned unchanged

410.description: Replay of an id whose completion was undone since: error `deleted`; clients drop the queued mark

post.description: Other members get a "done" push 10 s later, unless the completion was deleted (undone) in the meantime.

post.summary: Leave a household; the last member needs confirm_delete
Add a member by username or user id
post.description: Unknown user, already a member and `user_id` without `MEMBER_DIRECTORY` all answer the same 404 `cannot_add`; 20 adds per hour per user

429.description: Too many add attempts (20 per hour per acting user); `Retry-After` header

patch.summary: Update profile, password or notification settings

delete.description: Local accounts confirm with `current_password` (wrong: 403 `wrong_password`, counts towards the login rate limit), SSO accounts with `confirm_username` = their display name. Households left without members are deleted with their chores, completions, categories and invites.

get.summary: SSO provider callback; sets the session cookie and redirects

get.description: `client=android`: the callback redirects to `wgchores://auth?code=<one-time code>` (plus `&invite=<token>` when started from one; errors: `wgchores://auth?error=<code>`), no cookie is set. Missing or malformed challenge: 400.

post.summary: Exchange the app's one-time SSO code for a device token
post.description: The code is valid 60 s and single use: it is deleted on the first try, also when the verifier is wrong. Failed tries: 20 per client IP in 15 min. Needs header X-WGC: 1 (no bearer yet).

400.description: `invalid_code`: unknown, used, expired or wrong verifier

get.summary: List own sessions (browsers and app devices)

delete.summary: Sign out one of the own sessions

get.summary: App background check: done by others and newly due chores
get.description: Bearer only (cookie: 403 `app_only`). The cursor carries the done-event position and this poll's number: sending it acknowledges the due notices of that poll; due notices of a poll whose cursor never comes back are sent again. Done events appear only after the 10 s undo window. Without `since`: no done backlog, only what is due now. Bad cursor: 400 `invalid_cursor`.

get.summary: Digital Asset Links for the Android app
get.description: Package `ch.tomigorn.wgchores` with the fingerprints from `ANDROID_CERT_SHA256`; 404 when that is empty.

cookie.name: __Host-wgc_session
cookie.description: Session cookie; unsafe methods also need header X-WGC: 1 and a same-origin Origin

bearer.description: App device token from `POST /api/v1/auth/login` / `register` with `client: android` or `POST /api/v1/auth/app-token`. No CSRF header needed when no cookie is sent; cookie and bearer together: 400 `ambiguous_auth`. A web session token is not accepted as bearer, nor an app token as cookie.

min_app_version.description: oldest app version this server works with (`MIN_APP_VERSION`)

cursor.description: opaque; send as `since` next time (also acknowledges this answer's `due`)

done.description: completions by other members since `since` that are older than 10 s, oldest first, at most 50; none without `since` or with `notify_done` off

due.description: chores due whose period this device has not acknowledged yet; none with `notify_due` off

more.description: `done` was cut at 50: poll again with the new cursor
